info.cls_ename: Ph.D. Program, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 隨著人們對於網路需求的增加，網路安全的重要性與日俱增。本課程即在協助學生了解資訊隱藏的研究歷程與現況，分析及探討資訊隱藏技術的最新發展。本課程旨在使學生具備資訊隱藏的基本概念，進而促使更多優秀的學生投入相關領域之技術研發工作。
description.describe_eh: With the rising of network usage for people communicate with others, information privacy and security is getting more and more important. This course is mainly to assist the students to deeply realize the research status of data hiding technology. Furthermore, students will learn the skills of analyzing and exploring the newly developed data hiding technologies. The course is expected to establish the solid background in the area of data hiding. And then lead more students to engage in the R&D of the related areas of data hiding.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生了解資訊隱藏在日常生活的重要性。教導資訊隱藏的相關知識和方法。
targets.describe_en: Enable students to realize the importance of data hiding technology in our daily life Understand the principles and the theories of data hiding.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生專業知識之自我學習能力。訓練學生具有解決專業問題之能力。
targets.describe_en: Train students the capability of self-learning professional knowledge. Train students the ability of problem solving.

targets.describe_ch: 讓學生閱讀資訊隱藏相關之國際期刊論文，從中學習相關專業知識，並根據論文成果提出見解。
targets.describe_en: Enable students to learn the knowledge and present the opinions by reading international journal papers of data hiding technology.

targets.describe_ch: 訓練與培養學生口語報告之表達能力，並能清晰表達個人的思考與分析結果。
